title: Golden Wheel CS-5100BT
subtitle: Single-Needle Lockstitch Flatbed with Automatic Under-Trimming, Backtacking, and Wiper

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The Golden Wheel CS-5100BT is a single-needle lockstitch flatbed with automatic under-trimming, backtacking, and wiper — the 'BT' suffix denotes these three automatic thread-handling functions. Suited for medium-to-heavy material work in apparel production.
applications: General straight-stitch seaming on shirts, trousers, light workwear
Operations requiring automatic thread trimming, backtacking, and wiping
purposeAndApplication.industry: Garment manufacturing, shirts and trousers, light industrial assembly

overviewDescription: Made by Golden Wheel / Chee Siang Industrial Co., Ltd. (Taiwan). Part of the broader CS-5100 family — sub-variants include CS-5100-5 (no trimmer), CS-5100-5N-2T / CS-5100-5N-BT / CS-5100H / CS-5100HL / etc. The `-BT` suffix maps to the 'N-BT' variant = with thread trimmer and backtack. Confirmed by Star International (India dealer) 2020 YouTube demo titled 'CS-5100BT...automatic undertrimming & backtacking & wiper'.
